gloss: all day long, throughout the day

definitions.gloss: all day long, throughout the day
definitions.explanation: For the entire duration of a day; from morning to night.

examples.japanese: {一日中|いちにちじゅう}⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
{一日中|いちにちじゅう}⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っていた→降る：00839_furu⟧。
{一日中|いちにちじゅう}⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。

notes:
Means "all day long" — from morning to night without interruption. Used as a time adverb, typically placed at the beginning of a sentence or before the verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The suffix {中|じゅう} attached to a time period means "throughout that entire period."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一年中|いちねんじゅう}→一年中：17104_ichinenjuu⟧: all year round
- ⟦{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}→一晩中：20338_hitobanjuu⟧: all night long
- {一日中|いちにちじゅう}: all day long

NOTE ON READING:
Read as いちにちじゅう (not *いちにちちゅう). The suffix {中|じゅう} means "throughout" a time span, while ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ means "during" or "in the middle of" (e.g., ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧ = during a meeting).
